summary: Energy Services of America Corp filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, announcing that management will present at the East Coast IDEAS Investor Conference on June 11, 2026. The filing includes a press release as an exhibit and is furnished under Item 8.01 (Other Events). No corporate transaction, share repurchase, merger, tender offer, or special-situation event was disclosed. The filing is a routine investor-relations announcement, not a special situation.
